findings.issue: Redundant claims.ToList() after claims was already converted to a list.
Seeded admin user has a fixed known password.
The ProducesResponseType attribute still names ProblemDetails while the endpoint now returns a validation problem.
The AnyAsync check and the insert are not atomic, so two concurrent creates with the same new explicit id can both pass the check and the loser still gets a 500 from the primary key violation.
GET /api/promotions requires only an authenticated user, not the promotions scope; it matches other services but the story says the token must have the scope.
Hard-coded applicationUrl port 5231 with launchBrowser true may collide with or diverge from other services' launch settings.
